en: Illustrated postcard with a stylized black‑and‑white drawing of a woman overlaid on a richly colored medieval religious miniature that shows a crowned figure (likely Christ) surrounded by angels and saints. The background is purple with faint decorative text, and at the bottom right large white letters read a capital 'K' with the name 'Mariken van Nieumeghen'. The image visually references medieval Christian iconography and Dutch literature.
